title: core.reputation.signal_retracted v1
description: Published by CORE when a recorded signal is withdrawn on its producer's instruction. Published once: the withdrawal is single-valued, so a redelivered retraction changes nothing and announces nothing. Like the recorded event it carries the fact and nothing derived, and it names the kind and subject so a consumer accumulating the stream can undo exactly what the recorded event added.

reputation_signal_id.description: The signal that was withdrawn. The same identifier the recorded event carried.

organization_id.description: The tenant the signal belongs to.

subject_type.description: The kind of CORE entity the signal was about.

subject_id.description: The identity or organization the signal was about.

signal_kind.description: The kind of the withdrawn signal, restated so a consumer need not have kept the recorded event.

source_system.description: The producer that reported, and then withdrew, the signal.

source_reference.description: The producer's reference for the report.

retracted_at.description: When the withdrawal took effect, as instructed by the producer.
